description: Parkings vélos - Angers Loire Métropole is a dataset listed in Angers Loire Métropole - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Angers Loire Métropole. Liste des parkings à vélos collectifs et box sécurisés d'Angers Loire Métropole. Précisions à propos de certains champs du jeu de données: INTERMOD: intermodalité(s) proposée(s) à proximité de l'équipement BUSLIGNES: précision des lignes du réseau Irigo à proximité de l'équipement BUSLIBAR / BUSNOMAR: précision des arrêts du réseau Irigo à proximité de l'équipement Pour ... Coverage: Angers Loire Métropole. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are vélo, Catalogue SIG. The portal shows 164 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-angers-fr-portal.
